# Arrow of Deliverance Ministries International (ADMI)

> Also known as: ADM Global, Victory Chapel, Victory Family, ADMI Victory Chapel

## About

Arrow of Deliverance Ministries International (ADMI) is a vibrant Christian church located in Jalingo, Taraba State, Nigeria. Founded by Pastor Joseph M. Nwunuji and Pastor Mrs. Christable Joseph, the church is dedicated to empowering people to fulfill their potential in God through the gospel of Jesus Christ. ADMI operates under the vision of being "A Shining Light to the Nations," proclaiming the Gospel of Jesus Christ and bringing hope, truth, and salvation to the nations through the power of God's Word.

## Names and Aliases

- **Full Name**: Arrow of Deliverance Ministries International
- **Abbreviation**: ADMI
- **Brand**: ADM Global
- **Local Name**: Victory Chapel
- **Community Name**: Victory Family
- **Social Media**: ADMI Victory Chapel

## Location

Opposite State Polytechnic, Jalingo, Taraba State, Nigeria

## Services

The church holds regular services including Sunday worship, midweek Bible study, and special prayer meetings. Visit the events page for the latest schedule.

## Mission

Proclaiming the Gospel of Jesus Christ and bringing hope, truth, and salvation to the nations through the power of God's Word. "For this is what the Lord has commanded us: 'I have made you a light for the Gentiles, that you may bring salvation to the ends of the earth.'" — Acts 13:47 NIV
